## Word banks

Skip if this PR does not touch `word-banks.ts`.

- [ ] Labels are 18 characters or fewer
- [ ] Unique inside that bank (case-insensitive)
- [ ] No brands, slurs, living people
- [ ] No `&`, `=`, or `?`
- [ ] Placed next to related words (file is not alphabetized)
- [ ] `pnpm validate:banks` passed
